caption: The drawing depicts an oval-shaped plaque with a dark, shaded background. In the center of the plaque is a cylindrical lighthouse with horizontal bands and a slightly conical top. A coiled snake wraps around the middle of the lighthouse, extending from left to right. The bottom of the lighthouse is surrounded by stylized flames. At the top left of the lighthouse, the letter "F" is drawn, and at the top right, the letter "A" is depicted. There are two small round holes near the top and bottom edges of the oval plaque, suggesting mounting points. The drawing is rendered in grayscale, featuring detailed shading to represent depth and texture. The image is framed by a thin, rectangular border, and the signature "H. Bader" appears in the bottom left outside the border. The background outside the plaque is a lighter, unshaded tone.
title: Firemark
